conbody.p: With the vehicle on, select the setup icon () on the screen or SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceParking safetyCamera settings from the infotainment system screen to change the Rear View Monitor settings.
If Extend rear camera use is selected, the rear camera is displayed even when shifting from R (Reverse) to N (Neutral) or D (Drive).
If Rear view reference lines in the display information is selected, Rear view reference lines and Top Rear View Parking Guidance are displayed in the rear monitor.

note.p: The setting menu may not be available for your vehicle depending on the vehicle specifications.

The horizontal lines of the Rear View Parking Guidance indicate distances of 0.5 m (20 in), 1 m (40 in), and 2.3 m (91 in) from the vehicle. The horizontal scale of the Top View Parking Guidance indicates distances of tailgate opening distance and 1.5 m (60 in) from the vehicle.
